papers.title: Association Between Alzheimer Pathology, Sleep, and Cognition in Patients With Late-Onset Unexplained Epilepsy.
papers.reason: The study links EEG-derived spindle–slow-oscillation coupling to cognitive performance and Alzheimer pathology, but does not specifically examine executive function.

papers.title: Menopausal 'brain fog' or dementia?-a practical guide for clinicians.
papers.reason: This is a general clinical guide for distinguishing subjective menopausal cognitive symptoms from dementia without executive-function modelling or digital assessment.

papers.title: [Factors associated with the progression of mild cognitive impairment in patients with atrial fibrillation].
papers.reason: The paper predicts general vascular MCI progression from clinical factors and aggregate neuropsychological scores rather than modelling or specifically assessing executive function.

papers.title: [Clinical and functional characteristics of Parkinson's disease in patients with chronic kidney disease].
papers.reason: The clinical comparison reports diminished executive, visuospatial, attention, and memory performance in Parkinson's disease with kidney disease, although only through broad screening measures.

papers.title: Factors associated with digital health literacy among community-dwelling older adults in Japan: An in-person cross-sectional study.
papers.reason: General cognitive ability is examined only as a predictor of digital health literacy, with no executive-function process model or cognitive biomarker classification.

papers.title: Associations of diabetes status and physical activity with cognitive impairment and hippocampal volume in older adults.
papers.reason: The study concerns general cognitive impairment and hippocampal volume in relation to diabetes and physical activity without isolating executive processes.

papers.title: Boredom in Psychiatric Disorders: Another Dimensional Construct?
papers.reason: The review synthesizes EEG, neuroimaging, and behavioural evidence linking boredom to attentional regulation, theta dynamics, cognitive control, and frontoparietal systems.

papers.title: Half-dose rivaroxaban vs antiplatelet therapy for preventing silent cerebral embolism after left atrial appendage occlusion: the HALO-SCE trial.
papers.reason: Cognitive screening is a secondary clinical outcome of an antithrombotic trial and is not analysed at the level of executive function or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: Elevated endogenous glucagon‐like peptide‐1 as a novel Alzheimer's disease biomarker associated with neuroinflammation and Aβ pathology
papers.reason: The study combines blood biomarkers, neuropsychological assessment, imaging, and machine learning for Alzheimer diagnosis, but lacks a digital or executive-function-specific measure.

papers.title: Speech-Derived Digital Biomarkers from a Brief Video-Recorded Dual-Task Test Differentiate Mild Cognitive Impairment: A Multisite Cohort Study.
papers.reason: The paper directly uses speech-derived digital biomarkers from a video-recorded dual-task assessment to distinguish mild cognitive impairment across multiple sites.

papers.title: EEG Microstate Dynamics Across Sleep Stages in Alzheimer's Disease: A Pilot Study.
papers.reason: The pilot identifies sleep-stage-specific EEG microstate differences between Alzheimer patients and controls that correlate with cognitive status and may support EEG-based assessment.

papers.title: The effect of mental rotation training of hands for upper extremity motor function and cognition in people post-stroke: A randomized controlled trial.
papers.reason: The trial provides behavioural evidence that mental-rotation training may improve post-stroke cognition, but its primary focus is motor rehabilitation and cognition is measured only with the MoCA.
